name: Dredging Corporation of India Ltd
about: Dredging Corporation of India Limited (DCI) is engaged in providing integrated dredging services to ports, Indian Navy and other maritime organizations in India.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Position
The company is one of the largest companies in the domestic dredging market with over 80% market share in the maintenance dredging for major ports. [1]
